title: We planned a
home extension
in a week with Claude
slides.subtitle: Plans in 2D and 3D, a tracker and a builder tender pack, from one tool. Here is what it does and what we cannot claim yet.

slides.label: The problem
slides.detail: On past developments the big costs came from unexpected add-ons, not the work we priced. A changed layout, a missing socket, a wall that moved once the builder was on site.
slides.start: List the last three surprise costs on any job you have run. Which decision, made earlier, would have avoided each?

slides.label: What we built
slides.detail: Floor plans in 2D with a live 3D model, a view of each wall for sockets and lights, and a tracker for budget, programme, materials and payments. One tool, built with Claude only.
slides.start: Describe the tool you wish you had in plain English. That description is your first prompt.

slides.label: Plan and 3D, side by side
slides.caption: Edit the floor plan on the left and the 3D model updates on the right.

slides.label: The house in 3D
slides.caption: Orbit round it, hide the floors above, check what the extension will look like.

slides.label: The plan in 2D
slides.caption: Walls, rooms, doors, plus every socket, switch and light placed before the builder arrives.

slides.label: One version of the truth
slides.detail: Everyone involved, from trades to contractors, works from the same drawings and numbers, not three versions in three inboxes. Fewer misunderstandings means fewer paid-for mistakes.
slides.start: Pick one place where the current plan lives. Retire every other copy.

slides.label: The tender pack
slides.detail: A detailed pack, generated from the design, goes to every builder, so they all price the same job. Three quotes have come back from it.
slides.start: Ask each builder for a written, itemised quote and read the exclusions first.

slides.label: Time to build
slides.detail: About a week, with Claude as the only tool. It is built for one personal development project, not a product we sell.
slides.start: Build the smallest version that answers your biggest worry, then add to it.

slides.label: What we are not claiming
slides.detail: We have not measured a saving, and we will not invent one. So far: one set of plans, one tender pack and three quotes. It does not replace an engineer or a measured survey.
slides.start: Keep a contingency anyway. Which? and others suggest around 10 to 15 per cent.

title: Decide early.
Price the same job.
slides.body: Our own project, built for ourselves. Results are ours and will vary.
slides.cta: If this interests you, or you have an idea you want to bring to life, contact us.
